name: pers_pharma_binary_basket_2026-09-25
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs
strategy: I bet the Q4-2026 FDA calendar pays: a diversified basket of PDUFA names with positive revision flow, sized small because a CRL averages -33% over five days, plus large-cap pharma ballast (MRK, LLY, ABBV, AMGN) that carries the same dated catalysts with far less binary risk. I overweight names where analysts raised targets into the event (VRTX, AGIO, CORT, PRAX) and keep every single binary at or under 5%. I would be wrong if a cluster of CRLs lands in November-December, if the Section 232 pharma tariff go-live on Sept 29 hits unshielded names like VRTX and ARGX, or if large-cap pharma de-rates on MFN pricing before year-end.
what_i_did_not_buy: INO|no briefing row, no revision flow, zero news coverage
BTAI|no briefing row, no revision flow, zero news coverage
NUVL|no briefing row, no revision flow, zero news coverage
BLTE|valuation ran ahead of the Feb 12 2027 PDUFA
NTLA|nex-z HLA safety signal unresolved, Street rating Hold
VKTX|no dated PDUFA, pivotal data outside window
GPCR|no clean consensus target sourced, burn rate doubled
